certificationCard.description: This exam focuses on configuring the NPSP managed package for nonprofits, covering household accounts, donation processing, recurring giving, customisable rollups, engagement plans, and data migration.

keyConcepts.h2: Nonprofit Success Pack Consultant: Key Concepts for the Exam

blocks.heading: NPSP Installation and Configuration
blocks.body: NPSP is a managed package installed from **AppExchange**. The NPSP Settings page (in Setup or via the NPSP tile) controls all key configurations: Account model (Household vs Individual vs Organisation), relationship settings, payment behaviour, and rollup configuration. The Household Account model creates one Account per person (their household) — not the same as a standard person account. The 1-to-1 Account model creates one Account per Contact. The consultant selects and documents the correct model before implementation and understands that switching models after data entry is complex.

blocks.heading: Donation Processing and Gift Entry
blocks.body: NPSP Batch Gift Entry enables high-volume gift processing with a grid-style interface optimised for data entry staff. Gift commitments (pledges with instalment schedules) are different from Recurring Donations (which auto-generate future Opportunities). Payment processing integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Elevate) handle online donations. The Gift Entry process typically includes: data entry, payment capture, acknowledgement letter generation, and tax receipt production. The consultant configures the Batch Gift Entry templates, defines required fields, and sets up payment matching rules.

blocks.heading: Customisable Rollups (CRLP)
blocks.body: Customisable Rollups (CRLP) replaces the legacy NPSP rollup system with a flexible, admin-configurable framework. Rollup types: Soft Credit rollups, Opportunity rollups to Contact/Account/GAU. Each rollup definition specifies: the source object and field, the rollup operation (SUM, COUNT, AVERAGE, FIRST/LAST DATE), filter criteria (e.g., only Closed Won Opportunities), and the target field on the Contact or Account. CRLP calculates totals like Total Given, Largest Gift, Most Recent Gift Date. The consultant configures CRLP to match the organisation's donor KPI requirements.

blocks.heading: Engagement Plans and Levels
blocks.body: Engagement Plans create task-based workflows for stewardship and donor cultivation. An Engagement Plan Template defines a sequence of tasks assigned to roles over time — e.g., 3 days after a major gift: send thank you note (task 1); 30 days: handwritten letter from ED (task 2); 60 days: phone call from program staff (task 3). Levels assign donors to stewardship tiers based on giving amounts — Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum. Level **Assignment rules** automatically categorise donors and can trigger Engagement Plans. The consultant configures Levels and Plans to match the organisation's major donor stewardship strategy.

blocks.heading: Data Quality and Migration
blocks.body: NPSP Data Importer is a tool specifically designed for importing constituent and donation data into NPSP — handling the household model logic, matching existing records, and creating correct relationships. It is preferred over Data Loader for initial NPSP data migration. Deduplication: NPSP includes merge tools for duplicate Contact and Account records. Data quality validation: using NPSP's built-in validation plus custom **Validation Rules** to enforce data completeness. The consultant designs the data migration strategy — mapping source system fields to NPSP objects, testing in sandbox, and validating results before production migration.

scenarioTips.h2: How to Pass the Salesforce Nonprofit Success Pack Consultant Exam
scenarioTips.intro: The NPSP Consultant exam focuses specifically on configuring NPSP features for fundraising, constituent management, and reporting. The exam emphasizes practical configuration knowledge over architectural design.

blocks.heading: Recurring Donations Configuration
blocks.body: Know how to configure open-ended vs. fixed-length recurring donations, pause rules, and how recurring donation schedules generate Opportunities. Understand how Elevate (payment processor) integrates with recurring donations.

blocks.heading: Soft Credits & Household Rollups
blocks.body: Soft Credits track secondary donor credit (spouse, board member influence). Household Rollups aggregate giving totals at the household level. Know the rollup fields, their definitions, and how to customize them.

blocks.heading: Data Import Wizard for NPSP
blocks.body: Understand how to use the NPSP Data Import Wizard vs. standard Data Import Wizard for migrating constituent and gift data. Know field mappings and how to handle duplicate matching.

blocks.heading: Engagement Plans
blocks.body: Engagement Plans automate constituent stewardship tasks (thank-you calls, acknowledgment letters) triggered by donation milestones. Know how to configure Engagement Plan Templates and the task **assignment rules**.

blocks.heading: Reports & Dashboards for Nonprofits
blocks.body: Know key NPSP report types (NPSP Households, NPSP Soft Credits) and how to build fundraising dashboards tracking year-to-date giving, LYBUNT/SYBUNT donors, and retention rates.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP)?
options: A managed package that extends Salesforce for nonprofits (donations, households, etc.)
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP is a managed package that provides donation management, households, and nonprofit-specific features on Salesforce.

sampleQuestions.question: How does NPSP differ from Nonprofit Cloud (NPC)?
options: NPSP is the managed package; NPC is the industry solution that may include NPSP and more
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP is the managed package; Nonprofit Cloud is the broader industry solution that can include NPSP.

sampleQuestions.question: Which role does an NPSP Consultant typically fulfill?
options: Designing and implementing nonprofit managed package solutions in a customer-facing role
sampleQuestions.explanation: They design and implement NPSP and nonprofit package solutions in a customer-facing role.

sampleQuestions.question: What is a Household in NPSP?
options: A grouping of related contacts (e.g., family) for giving and communications
sampleQuestions.explanation: Households group related contacts for household-level giving and communication.

sampleQuestions.question: Which NPSP feature supports recurring donations?
options: Recurring Donations object with installment opportunities
sampleQuestions.explanation: The Recurring Donations object creates installment opportunities based on the donation schedule.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the Gift Entry feature in NPSP?
options: A streamlined interface for entering and processing donations
sampleQuestions.explanation: Gift Entry provides a streamlined interface for donation entry.

sampleQuestions.question: Which NPSP setting controls soft credit behavior?
options: Household settings and soft credit allocation
sampleQuestions.explanation: Household settings control soft credit allocation.

sampleQuestions.question: What does NPSP data model support for nonprofits?
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP supports donations, households, affiliations, and engagements.

sampleQuestions.question: Which NPSP feature supports payment processing?
options: Payment object and payment gateway integration
sampleQuestions.explanation: Payment object and gateways support payment processing.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the purpose of NPSP migration?
options: To move data from legacy systems or customize NPSP
sampleQuestions.explanation: Migration moves data from legacy or custom implementations.

sampleQuestions.question: Which reporting need is common for NPSP?
options: Donor retention, campaign ROI, and gift summary
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP reporting covers donor retention and gift summary.

sampleQuestions.question: What does the Engagement Plan support?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Engagement Plans create stewardship task sequences.

sampleQuestions.question: Which integration is common for NPSP?
options: Payment processors, fundraising platforms, and accounting
sampleQuestions.explanation: NPSP integrates with payment and fundraising platforms.

sampleQuestions.question: What does an NPSP Consultant need to understand?
options: NPSP data model, nonprofit processes, and configuration
sampleQuestions.explanation: Consultants need NPSP data model and nonprofit process knowledge.

sampleQuestions.question: Which best practice applies to NPSP implementation?
options: Clean data, align with nonprofit processes, and train users
sampleQuestions.explanation: Clean data, process alignment, and training support success.
